title: Coefficient transport of the strict pulled reduction limit before the reflector comparison
statement: Fix ell,E,g:X→Y with ell invertible on both schemes, with the interfaces of [def-pod-integral-completed-comparison-data]. Fix a normalized finite strict-tower comparison C [lem-a1-finite-pullback-strict-tower-comparison], normalized ordinary finite comparisons e_n:finiteIntegral_n≅finiteCompleted_n, and a natural isomorphism a from the published strict completed pullback to actual completed pullback preserving their units on all inputs. There exists b from the strict completed pullback followed by exact coefficient restriction to H=finiteTowerLimit(C) of [lem-a1-integral-roos-finite-tower-realization]. On every good transported complex P and every level n, b_QP followed by H’s specified computation projection and Q(e_n) equals exact coefficient restriction of the published strict limit projection followed by the published finite evaluation, and then finiteComputation(P,n). The composite of coefficient restriction of a inverse with b commutes with all retained integer shifts. The displayed equation is before precomposition by any reflector-to-strict comparison, and has no intrinsic-completeness hypothesis. No comparison with the integral Roos pullback is asserted.

proof.text: The unique coefficient isomorphisms identify positive quotients, transitions and quotient units. Completed structural maps agree after every quotient projection and hence agree into the completed ring limit. Exact restriction therefore identifies the ordinary scalar-extension adjunctions and their strict diagram versions. Their universal derived counits transport the reduction and tower pullback pairs.

Compose the transported strict tower comparison with C.b, then apply total right derived inverse limit. Exact coefficient restriction is an equivalence and transports that derived pair and its canonical projections, giving b.

For a good representative use C.zigzag to express the finite computation counit as the Koszul augmentation followed by its balanced comparison. The prescribed normalization of e_n identifies that balanced comparison with the published finite evaluation: both send every pulled quotient-unit generator to the same section. The existing uniqueness assertion for the ordinary finite evaluation justifies the identification. Applying the natural derived-limit projection gives exactly the displayed equation.

All coefficient comparisons commute termwise with shifts. The reduction, tower and finite shift descent fields of C identify these with the retained derived shifts. The derived-limit comparison respects shifts by its universal unit. The strict and actual completed pullbacks represent the same completion reflection with the same quotient augmentation. Unit uniqueness identifies any given a with the constructed comparison, so the composite of a inverse and b has the asserted CommShift equation. This uses neither detection of arbitrary derived morphisms by finite evaluations nor exactness of ordinary completed pullback.

theorem strictIntegral_coefficientTowerTransport
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y))
    (C : FinitePullbackStrictTower.Comparison.{u, u} l E g)
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, finiteIntegral l E g n ≅ finiteCompleted l E g n)
    (he : ∀ n : ℕ, FiniteNormalization l E g n (e n))
    (a : pbcActualStrictCompletedPull (pbcIntegralDatum l E) g ≅
      pbcActualCompletedPull g (pbcIntegralDatum l E))
    (ha : ∀ K : PbcCompletedDerived Y (pbcIntegralDatum l E),
      (pbcActualStrictCompletedPullUnit (pbcIntegralDatum l E) g).app K ≫ a.hom.app K =
        (pbcActualCompletedPullUnit g (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).app K) :
    ∃ b : pbcActualStrictCompletedPull (pbcIntegralDatum l E) g ⋙ derived l E X ≅
        finiteTowerLimit l E g C,
      (∀ (P : CochainComplex
          (pbcModules Y (pbcAdicCompletion Y (pbcIntegralDatum l E))) ℤ)
        (hP : integralOperationsGoodComplex.{u, u} l E Y ((complexes l E Y).obj P))
        (n : ℕ),
        b.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫ finiteTowerLimitProjection l E g C P n ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map ((finiteComplexComparison l E g n (e n)).app P) =
          (derived l E X).map
            ((completedReductionLimitProjection (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (X := X) n).app
              ((completedTowerPullback g (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).obj
                ((completedReductionTower Y (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).obj
                  (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))) ≫
              (completedReductionFiniteEvaluation g (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n).hom.app
                (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫ finiteComputation l E g P n) ∧
      NatTrans.CommShift (Functor.isoWhiskerRight a.symm (derived l E X) ≪≫ b).hom ℤ
